title: statusline r2 UX: composition instruction presumes an editable shell wrapper
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 2. Lens: ux (validator: documentation-reviewer). Owner: SO session. Defect: 'exact invocation line to add' plus compose-by-concatenation only maps onto a wrapper-script statusLine; an adopter with an inline one-liner or opaque command has no line to add — the no-doc-lookup guarantee fails for the common non-wrapper case; the criterion narrows the test to a seeded wrapper. Citations verified: contract:159, :184. Proposed: deferred to the phase-1c wiring-script shape work item (instruction must handle non-wrapper shapes or emit a shape-appropriate wrapper). Failure: refusal path dead-ends for non-wrapper adopters.
